input.command:
(PORT=3917 node .output/server/index.mjs > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; B=http://localhost:3917
echo "--- quote"; curl -s -X POST $B/api/cart/quote -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":1}],"code":"save10"}'; echo
echo "--- POST order"; R=$(curl -s -X POST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":1}],"code":"save10"}'); echo $R
ID=$(echo $R | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).id')
echo "--- GET order"; curl -s $B/api/orders/$ID; echo
echo "--- GET missing"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $B/api/orders/nope
echo "--- POST bad"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"x","qty":0}]}'
echo "--- page"; curl -s $B/orders/$ID | grep -oE '<li class="order-line">.{0,200}|id="order-total">[^<]*|id="order-subtotal">[^<]*' | head; echo
echo "--- page missing"; curl -s $B/orders/nope | grep -o 'Order not found' | head -1
pkill -f ".output/server/index.mjs"; echo done
